text: Thank you, Mr. Clark, for your good wishes.
I'll carry on from where you left off.
The evidence for the existence of flying saucers
is so overwhelming that I have long ago accepted it.
I am therefore very little interested in stories of fresh sightings
unless they refer to some new or rare type of vehicle.
What I am interested in is any report or account of personal contact with the occupants,
however far-fetched the story may appear to be.
It is by analyzing and correlating these often conflicting accounts
that we shall sooner or later amass a volume of evidence
which will enable us to form a useful theory
about the facts of interplanetary flight.
